mergewith.subtemplate:
<!-- No lower bound: centered mode treats this as a rate multiplier (kept positive by its LogNormal prior); non-centered mode stores unbounded Normal(0,1) deviates instead. --> <parameter id="MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" dimension="1">1</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0">0.5</parameter>
<parameter id="MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0" dimension="1">1</parameter>
<parameter id="MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0.2">2</parameter>
<parameter id="MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0">0.01</parameter>
<!-- Hierarchical prior for spikeMean: its LogNormal prior below uses this as its M. --> <parameter id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0" estimate="false">0.01</parameter>
<parameter id="MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0">1</parameter>
<parameter id="MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.BooleanParameter" name="stateNode" estimate="false">1</parameter>
<!-- rateSD is always wired to MTSMclockSD.c:$(n); only used when nonCentered="true". --> <branchRateModel id="MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.clockmodel.PunctuatedClockModel" indicator="@MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" clock.rate="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spikeMean="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" rates="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" rateSD="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" relaxed="true"> </branchRateModel>
<!-- Needs BDMM-Prime's own parameterization/bdmDistr/startTypePriorProbs for this partition. --> <prior id="MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" spec="multitypespike.distribution.BranchSpikePrior" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spikeShape="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" parameterization="@CanonicalBDMMPrimeParameterization.t:$(n)" bdmDistr="@BDMMPrime.t:$(n)" startTypePriorProbs="@startTypePriorProbs.t:$(n)"/>
<prior id="MTSMclockRatePrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)"> <Gamma name="distr"> <parameter name="alpha" value="10" estimate="false" lower="0"/> <parameter name="beta" value="0.01" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </Gamma> </prior>
<prior id="MTSMclockSDPrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)"> <Gamma name="distr"> <parameter name="alpha" value="5" estimate="false" lower="0"/> <parameter name="beta" value="0.05" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </Gamma> </prior>
<!-- Two mutually-exclusive priors on branchRates - exactly one is connected below, gated on the nonCentered checkbox. M is fixed at 1, not hyperprior-able: branchRates is a rate multiplier and its mean must stay 1 for identifiability against clock.rate. --> <prior id="MTSMbranchRatePriorCentered.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"> <LogNormal meanInRealSpace="true" name="distr" M="1" S="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)"/> </prior>
<prior id="MTSMbranchRatePriorNonCentered.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"> <Normal name="distr" mean="0" sigma="1"/> </prior>
<prior id="MTSMspikeMeanPrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)"> <LogNormal name="distr" meanInRealSpace="true" M="@MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)"> <parameter name="S" value="0.6" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </LogNormal> </prior>
<prior id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMeanPrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)"> <Exponential name="distr"> <parameter name="mean" value="0.01" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </Exponential> </prior>
<prior id="MTSMspikeShapePrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)"> <LogNormal name="distr" meanInRealSpace="true"> <parameter name="M" value="2" estimate="false" lower="0"/> <parameter name="S" value="0.5" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </LogNormal> </prior>
<!-- multitypespike operators --> <operator id="MTSMSpikeFlipOperator.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.SpikeFlipOperator" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spikeShape="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" parameterization="@CanonicalBDMMPrimeParameterization.t:$(n)" weight="30.0"/>
<operator id="MTSMSpikeUpRateDown.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.SpikeUpDownOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" parameterization="@CanonicalBDMMPrimeParameterization.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="20.0"/>
<operator id="MTSMTargetedSpikeOperator.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.TargetedSpikeOperator" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" branchSpikePrior="@MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="10.0"/>
<!-- Standard scale/bitflip operators on the parameters this template creates --> <operator id="MTSMclockRateScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMclockSDScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeShapeScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeMeanScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMeanScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMlatentSpikesScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="30.0"/> <operator id="MTSMBitFlipOperator.c:$(n)" spec="BitFlipOperator" uniform="true" parameter="@MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" weight="1.0"/>
<!-- ORCRatesScale only valid when nonCentered="false" (assumes a strictly-positive rate multiplier), so it's added via a gated <connect> below rather than nested here. ORCRatesRandomWalk has no such assumption and stays nested unconditionally. --> <operator id="MTSMAdaptableOperatorSamplerRatesInternal.c:$(n)" spec="AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="20.0"> <parameter idref="MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"/> <tree idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="MTSMORCRatesRandomWalk.c:tree.c:$(n)" spec="operator.kernel.BactrianRandomWalkOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="1.0"> <kernelDistribution spec="operator.kernel.KernelDistribution$Bactrian"/> </operator> </operator>
<operator id="MTSMORCRatesScale.c:tree.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" upper="10.0" weight="1.0"> <kernelDistribution spec="operator.kernel.KernelDistribution$Bactrian"/> </operator>
<!-- Loggers --> <log id="MTSMrateStat.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.RateStatistic" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" branchratemodel="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMSaltativeProportionLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.SaltativeProportionLogger" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" clock="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMSpikeLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.SpikeLogger" clock="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMHiddenEventsLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.HiddenEventsLogger" branchSpikePrior="@MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" indicator="@MTSMindicator.c:$(n)"/>
Multi-type spike relaxed clock mean of partition c:$(n)
Multi-type spike relaxed clock stdev of partition c:$(n)
Multi-type spike relaxed clock branch rates of partition c:$(n) (centered).
Multi-type spike relaxed clock branch rates of partition c:$(n) (non-centered). Must stay Normal(0,1) - do not change this distribution or its parameters.
Multi-type spike relaxed clock spike mean of partition c:$(n).
Hierarchical hyperprior on the mean of the spike mean of partition c:$(n)

Multi-type spike branch spike prior of partition c:$(n)
Up/down rates and spikes of partition c:$(n)
